worldfile.export.heading: Export world file
worldfile.export.text: Downloads the world as one ZIP file to import into another Foreman: its saves, mods, mod settings and game settings.
worldfile.export.saves.loaded: Only the save that loads next
worldfile.export.saves.loaded_hint: A smaller file. Older saves and autosaves stay behind.
worldfile.export.running: If the game is running, the file holds its last save on disk, which may be a few minutes behind what players see. Stop the game first to include everything.
worldfile.export.left_out: The file does not hold snapshots, the game password, or Foreman's records of this world, such as its audit log, restart schedule and notifications.
worldfile.export.audit: Each export is recorded in the audit log.
worldfile.export.warning: Saves and the mod settings file can hold what a mod stores, such as a token. Share the file only with people you trust.
worldfile.import.heading: Import a world file
worldfile.import.intro: Upload a file made by Export world on another Foreman. You see what it holds before anything is imported.
